thread:
Saira: Heads-up — HarborPay (customer onboarded via SI AtlasSys) is blocked on private deploy. Atlas agent fails pulling our marketplace image and webhooks to control plane time out. Getting a 403 + TLS handshake errors. Can we get a network/marketplace SME? @Devon @Maria
Devon: on it. can you paste the exact error output they see?
Saira: pasted from Atlas logs:
```
curl -v https://images.redwood.ai/harborpay/edge-image:20260201 -o /tmp/image.tar
* Connected to images.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake: server sent alert: handshake failure
* Closing connection 0
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```
Also their control-plane webhook calls to `https://control.redwood.ai/v1/attach` get `connect: connection refused` behind their firewall.
Jake: sounds like TLS interception / proxy blocking egress. Many corporate NGFWs do TLS MITM which breaks our image signature attestation. Ask Atlas to check SNI passthrough for images.redwood.ai and s3.redwood.ai (we use S3 for artifacts).
Devon: +1. Also confirm their egress NAT doesn't rewrite source IP — our attestation expects preserved client cert info in the handshake. If proxy terminates TLS, signatures fail.
Maria: I'll message the Atlas PM. Saira, can you request their firewall/proxy config (host + port allowlist) so we can be specific? Meanwhile, is there a temporary workaround to keep HarborPay moving?
Saira: Atlas asked for a workaround, they can't change corporate policy immediately.
Devon: short-term: we can provide a pre-pulled signed artifact they can fetch from a customer-accessible host (HTTP) or push to their internal registry.
DeployBot: pre-signed prebake created for harborpay: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/prepull/harborpay-2234567890.tar.gz (expires 24h) :package:
Saira: trying the prebake now — brb.
Saira: prebake pull succeeded and node started. Customer is unblocked for initial testing.
Maria: great. Action items captured: 1) Atlas to update firewall to allow SNI passthrough or whitelist images.redwood.ai and s3.redwood.ai; 2) Atlas to confirm NAT/source-IP behavior for attestation; 3) Redwood (Devon) to share attestation troubleshooting doc and sample proxy/iptables rules; 4) Schedule architecture review with SI + customer to harden go-live path. I'll set up Tue 10:00am PST.
Devon: I'll prepare the attestation doc + proxy config snippets and share before the review.
Jake: would add: if they must keep inspection, recommend an internal pull-through registry (Atlas can mirror signed images) — that'll avoid TLS breakage.
Saira: thanks everyone. Logging this as an implementation escalation for the engagement tracker and flagging for marketplace team follow-up.
Maria: thank you — I'll include product + marketplace + SI PM on the invite. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Reminder archived: prebake artifact will auto-delete at expiry.
Saira: closing the immediate blocker. We'll update the thread after the architecture review.
